name: Sooha Ryu
source:
A musician with a complicated past. 
He may seem carefree and a little impulsive, but his childhood has a whirlwind– ...dragged through his youth by grown-ups and consumed by the public. 

"I hope you're here for me now."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/moond/moonlight-dialogue-an-otome-visual-novel-for-mobile/description/]Kickstarter[/url]]
